name: IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per ticket for delays of 12+ hours or requiring an overnight stay.

tripCancellation.notes: Covers non-refundable prepaid trip costs up to $10,000 per trip.

lostBaggage.notes: Covers lost, damaged, or stolen bags. High-risk items (electronics, jewelry) limited to $500.

baggageDelay.notes: $100 per day for up to 5 days for checked baggage delays of 6+ hours.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 referrals for medical, legal, and travel emergencies. Actual costs are cardholder's responsibility.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary rental car coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Must decline CDW at the counter. Covers up to 31 consecutive days.

otherCredits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
otherCredits.notes: One free night reward annually after account anniversary. Redeemable at IHG Hotels & Resorts worldwide at properties up to 40,000 IHG One Rewards points per night.

otherCredits.name: 4th Night Free
otherCredits.notes: When you redeem IHG One Rewards points for stays of 4+ nights, you get the 4th night free. Effectively reduces cost of 4-night reward stays by 25%.

rewards.travelRate: 26x at IHG Hotels & Resorts (10x from card + 10x from IHG Rewards program + 6x Platinum Elite bonus)

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.5–0.8¢ per IHG point; best redeemed for IHG hotel stays

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Visit chase.com or call the number on back of card
